                                                                    PM FIRE WEATHER FORECAST
                                                                                     ISSUED: 1500 Monday May 15 2023

                             RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FOR
             OJ/FV/MA/RE/GP/MM/PY/LB ZONES FOR TOMORROW’S BURNING PERIOD
                                   RED FLAG WATCH IN EFFECT FOR
                            SH/ED ZONES FOR TOMORROW’S BURNING PERIOD
A cold front continues southeast through the province, approaching ED/SH/LB by midnight producing a significant wind shift from SE
to NW. Widespread northerly wind gusts exceeding 40 km/h are likely along the central and eastern boreal and the eastern
slopes, creating a particularly dangerous overnight fire situation.
For tomorrow: The cold front departs with afternoon showers possible in the southern Rockies and northeast boreal. High
temperatures range from 15-20 in the north and 25-30 in southern zones, with RH minima between 15-20% in the western boreal
and foothills and 35-45 in the northeast and mountain parks. Boreal winds are NW15-20 km/h, while southern Alberta 15-20 km/h
southwesterlies become northwest with the passage of the cold front. Gusts exceeding 50 km/h are possible in central and eastern
zones, with the strongest winds in PY/MM. This wind shift coupled with extreme FWI indices will produce a potentially dangerous
situation for southern regions into Tuesday’s burn period.
Outlook for Wednesday: Winds weaken in the northwest as high pressure settles, with NE winds 15-20 km/h continuing in the
northeast slopes and southern zones. High temperatures are 15-20C province-wide, with RH minima between 20-30% except for 40-
50% in eastern MM/LB near the low in SK. Precipitation is scarce, confined to WA/CH zones the far northeast FV zone.

Outlook for Thursday: Shower chances dissipate early Thursday in the southern Rockies as high pressure builds. Temperatures range
from 15-20C province wide, with RH minima between 15-20% in the north and 20-25% in the south. Winds are southerly 15-20 in
northern and northerly at 15-20 in CH, with gusts to 35 km/h possible in northern OJ and SH zones.
